card.name: Verbs introducing availability or requirements
card.fires_on: The word "available" after "is" when a product's supply form is described (e.g. in glass cartridges or flexible containers). Also "must" after "opioid analgesic products" in REMS text.

modes.label: Supplied-as statement
modes.description: "is available" introducing the container or packaging of an injection product.
modes.example: Ciprofloxacin injection is<< available>> as a 0.2% prem

modes.label: REMS obligation
modes.description: "must" after "approved opioid analgesic products" in REMS requirement text.
modes.example: drug companies with approved opioid analgesic products<< must>> make REMS-compliant education programs available

card.plain: It marks the verb that states how a product is supplied or what companies are required to do.
